study_type_evidence.quote: The pharmacokinetics of free CDDP and various PLG-CDDP nanoformulations were evaluated by single tail vein injection into healthy rats
The PLG-CDDP nanoformulations without PEG shell had enhanced cell uptake and cytotoxicity.

in_vivo_species.quote: Female Sprague-Dawley rats were purchased from Beijing HFK Bioscience Co., Ltd. ... randomly divided into five groups (n = 3; average weight: 180 g)

in_vitro_detail: Cell uptake and cytotoxicity of the PEG-detached nanoformulations.

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Pharmacokinetics of CDDP and PLG-CDDP nanoformulations after intravenous injection into Sprague-Dawley rats.
concentration_time_figure.note: Mean serum platinum concentration vs time; derived parameters in Supplementary Table S4, not in the retrieved text.

bioanalytical_method: ICP-MS (PerkinElmer NexION) of nitric-acid-digested plasma for platinum content; parameters computed in PKSolver
bioanalytical_quote: plasma samples were decomposed by heating with nitric acid, and the platinum contents were determined by inductively coupled plasma-mass spectrometry
notes: EXCLUDED FROM THE TRAINING SET on two independent grounds, both confirmed here. (1) The measured analyte is PLATINUM by ICP-MS, i.e. cisplatin, not a peptide - the four values 1.9, 8.8, 7.9 and 7.8 h are the drug's plasma half-life and the paper attributes their differences to the PEG shell shielding the nanoparticle from clearance, not to any peptide. (2) PEPlife2's Sequence field for these records is not a sequence but the polymer's NAME, 'Poly(L-glutamic acid)' (and 'PLGLAG-Poly(L-glutamic acid)' for the MMP-cleavable variant), which the training-set sequence cleaner reduces to the residue string POLYLGLUTAMICACID. PEPlife2 IDs 4968, 4969, 4970 and 4972 are dropped via CURATED_NOT_A_HALF_LIFE. A fifth record, PEG-pHe-PLG-Pt at pH 6.5, carries the literal value 'N.A.' and is removed earlier by the requirement for a numeric half-life. Only the PLGLAG hexapeptide in PEG-MMP-PLG-Pt is an actual peptide, and it is an MMP-2-cleavable linker within the polymer, not the dosed agent.
